memory_state_inventory.indirect_effects: All nonstack mutations are made by the listed helpers/callback. The direct function does not store globals; helper order and pointer arguments are mapped above. No array indexing or persistent direct pointer arithmetic occurs.

static_axes.cfg: All 16 conditional transfers in 0x0239-0x037E are listed. The only cycle is the input poll backedge 0x0342 -> 0x02F5, reached on absent events or unrecognized event codes. Keyboard polling has priority: a recognized key bypasses event fetch; an unknown key falls through to event fetch. Three key classes and three event codes assign results 0/1/2 and join one cleanup tail; no other return exists.
static_axes.constants_widths_signedness: The resource key expression and all constants are 16-bit target ints; g_5A97 alone is an 8-bit char. The key dispatch's unsigned upper guard makes its later AL-difference chain equivalent to exact 16-bit switch cases. Event codes are 16-bit equality checks. Font/width/object IDs and zero callback args are preserved.
static_axes.pointer_arithmetic_and_abi: Only (0x41 - which) * 2 computes the resource selector. For win_Open, the one explicit word 0x2100 is followed in the target by four physical stack reads at callee BP+8,+0xA,+0xC,+0xE, which map to o15 saved SI, saved DI, and its as-yet-uninitialized BP-0x28/-0x26 homes. The registered MSC candidate uses the same 40-byte frame, DI-then-SI saves, one-word push, and identical machine prefix through this call; all four values therefore match for equal entry machine state. Fastcall register/stack placement for the other helpers agrees with the pinned declarations.
static_axes.calls_and_order: All 18 far/runtime calls are in call_map in machine order. Resource acquire -> text lookup -> font setup -> optional rect/background adjustment -> second rect -> color -> text print -> font reset -> keyboard/event arbitration -> unlock -> release -> close -> return. This matches the entire C function lines 167-217.
static_axes.observable_effects_and_state: Direct globals read are g_3DB2, g_5A97, g_9128; direct global writes none. Helper-visible state is affected by ordered calls and far pointer contents. Handle unlock precedes release; window close follows release. Stack result is fully assigned before cleanup/return on every terminating path.
static_axes.dependency_boundaries: The registered function source and its direct call sequence are fully accounted. The 0x2100 DB resource has no mode-5 axis, but the proof does not depend on that restriction: the candidate passes the same four raw words to win_Open for arbitrary equal entry stack/register states, and the mode-5 diagnostic shows the effect is shared by original and candidate. The behavioral contract still excludes raster pixels, actual clipping-list internals, private timer backend/future callbacks, physical device state and invalid resource behavior.
static_axes.complete_algorithm: Setup, optional rectangle branch, keyboard dispatch, event dispatch, retry loop, cleanup and return map to every original path. The varargs stack reads are now statically accounted at the call boundary, including both saved-register words and both uninitialized frame words. Whole-module comparison proves the candidate uses the same inputs at win_Open for any identical entry machine state; the only two instruction differences are a later text-segment stack-home displacement and its matching reload, with no alias to those inputs.

remaining_differences.explanation: The complete whole-module MSC comparison has equal 326-byte extents and 137 instructions, with only two BP displacement bytes differing: the target stores/reloads the text pointer segment word at BP-0x06, while the candidate uses BP-0x02. Both hold the same DX value, and these homes do not overlap the win_Open inputs at BP-0x2C/-0x2A/-0x28/-0x26. No semantic mismatch is established.

stack_call_audit.source_safe_repair: No source semantic repair is indicated. Keep the one-word historical call and account for the physical reads. Adding four zero/guessed arguments would replace the target stack values for mode-5 resources; merely changing the extern declaration to ellipsis would not materialize those words. The source-level BP-0x28/BP-0x26 contents are uninitialized until cleanup, so a natural C expression for them does not exist without changing the ABI/state model.

The sole two text-segment home displacements are a paired store/reload after that call, with no other home use/alias. No resource-mode assumption is needed.
